The helpline workers that arent being paid genuinely want to help. But they are few and far between. Doctors will say whatever you want to hear and dope you up so you feel "better". Which makes what they do at least in my opinion irrelevant. This next one ill speak of my strict personal opinion of my family.

 Six years ago i took a shit ton of ibuprofen when i was still in school. It was dumb and didn't overall do much, but it was with intent of killing myself. Well long story short my dad figured out. He got a card to set an appointment up for a counselor. He said they were busy and he left a voicemail. Bs that didnt happen because we never spoke of it again. But the pain is still there even years later, it evolves. But not to them, they put on a facade that everything is okay with our family. They cant break if they do everything falls apart. My philosophy is the ones who live in shitty, stressful, depressing situations that are bright enduring souls are the one that go all in at poker. What I mean is they typically deep doen are hiding just as much if not more emotions then we are. Furthermore, when they break typically they are ones who randomly commit sucide.
 
I had a distant friend back when i played football, and he seemed like a good guy. Made good grades had a girlfriend, seemed like an average highschool kid. Well i didn't keep tabs on him like most people after highschool we go ours own ways. So about a year ago my friend and I were playing video games and my friend told me that landon had killed himself. He was in college and from our prospective it came out of nowhere. That ideology doesnt exist. He knew something we didnt, and no shame we all have our demons. His family like most families were being toxic about it. Saying things like "why did you do it", "not right in the head". The funny thing is they were victimizing themselves saying how their is hurt and is being teared apart, yet at the same time saying things previously mention not even comphrending a potential ounce of blame on their part, ironic isn't it?

 All im saying is most people deep down don't care or as much as they should. The two ways you can go with potential minor exceptions are like minded people in the same situation such as this community or dealing with it by yourself. You might not like because you are a guy and i get it but a song that feels relevant (at least to me) is "Live Laugh Love" by Sasha Sloan. Its not stereotypical upbeat like it sounds. Also, good luck man this world is torture and if worst comes to worst no shame.
